description: Add retry logic to the concurrency lease renewal loop to handle transient failures gracefully. Currently, a single network or server error causes the renewal loop to crash permanently, which terminates flow runs. Implement retry mechanisms with exponential backoff to maintain lease continuity during temporary issues.
functional_requirements: Wrap the lease renewal function with the existing `retry_async_fn` decorator to automatically retry failed renewal attempts
Configure the retry logic to allow up to 3 consecutive failures per renewal attempt before propagating the error
Implement exponential backoff between retry attempts to prevent overwhelming the server during transient issues
Enhance failure logging to include `exc_info` in error messages, providing users with diagnostic information for troubleshooting renewal failures
Ensure the retry logic only applies to the lease renewal operation and doesn't affect other concurrency management functions
